normalization: NFKD, remove combining/format marks and tatweel, map Arabic final ya, retain all letters/numbers and word separation. Current primary Arabic names only; no aliases, directional/numeric removal or prefix stripping on locality names.
strictGroupRequirements: Every existing locality-group member must have the exact normalized primary name and governorate.
Base point must be covered by every polygon member in current original source and packed geometry.
All members must already use the same eligible manual prayer source as the base, independently recomputed.
Current coded sector identity and displayed parent must agree with INS2024; failed sector identity cannot be bypassed through a broader namesake.
Alternatively require an explicit source place tag or one unique current namesake coded parent containing the entire original group footprint.
Each target base and source group must be unique; no new alias, proximity or transitive grouping.
remainingWork: Root chooses whether to implement these exact reviewed IDs with source assertions; this proposal changes nothing. The15 same-subtitle pairs have a separate independent review.
limitations: Source polygons are not certified by this display-group proposal.
Existing base phone search observations corroborate names only, not full polygon containment or administrative identity. Stale flags and limited search outcomes are reported.
No source extraction batch, phone actions, tests, builds, generator execution or repository edits were performed.
